source.patch_scope: For the Clef architecture only, select output.weight storage for its actual GET_ROWS use, leaving other architectures and all other matrix weights unchanged.

build.method: Applied the canonical zero-fuzz patch to the previously verified source; rebuilt llama-server incrementally with CMake --parallel 2; copied to a new artifact without replacing the original binary.
build.linked_libraries: macOS system frameworks and /usr/lib only; no Homebrew or Python library

build_guards.regression_scope: Patched compilable loader slice chooses GET_ROWS only for Clef output; positive offline builder packaging; patch digest and context-drift refusal before compiler execution. This is not a full model calculation.

forbidden_inference: Patched native compilation and operator classification do not establish trained inference, numerical BF16 parity, model accuracy, application utility or measured speedup. Trained execution requires its separate runtime witness.
